timing.state_timing: current before command; next after five physics steps; terminal transition included

frames.v_up: negative world CV vertical velocity; equals clearance rate for level motion
frames.force_up: negative world vertical realized thruster force

action.description: Open-loop symmetric vertical commands U[4]=U[5]=u_z; U[0:4]=0. No PID.
action.schedule_generation: Independent NumPy default_rng(episode seed), shuffled amplitude/dwell pools, random block sign; only whole blocks; remaining tail zero
action.simulation_rng: A separate NumPy default_rng with the same episode seed

guards.contact_detection: Check gondola floor/ceiling clearance after every physics substep

limitations: Vertical-only, level initial states; no lateral or attitude excitation
Neutral trim, no drift or draught
No payload mass or inertia changes
No model fitted or performance claim
